deviation.reason: One verifier exists. A two-person rule with one available person produces either permanent QUORUM_SHORT or invented second identities, and an invented identity is far worse than an honest quorum of one. The deviation is recorded here and reported by tools/verify_status.py on every run rather than hidden in a default.
conditions: Every rule value still carries a named verifier, a source edition, a date, and a bound content hash. Nothing about the attestation weakens.
An imported seed carrying no named verifier still counts for nothing, at any quorum.
This deviation does not extend to any evaluator output shown to a Marine. Before a computed entitlement reaches a member, restore quorum 2.
Revisit when a second verifier exists, or before the first production use, whichever comes first.
